svg.title: How a kilowatt-hour becomes a location-based and a market-based figure
svg.desc: Every kilowatt-hour of purchased electricity is priced at the grid factor of the facility's region to give the location-based figure, which the inventory total uses. For the market-based figure, the kilowatt-hours an instrument covers are priced at the instrument's factor, provided the instrument meets all eight Scope 2 Quality Criteria; the balance, and every facility without an instrument, is priced at the residual mix where one is published, or at the grid average where none is. The transmission and distribution losses of category 3 are computed on every kilowatt-hour at the location-based factor.
